# Output Schema — `design-tokens.json` (W3C DTCG)

Use the [W3C Design Tokens Community Group](https://www.w3.org/community/design-tokens/) format. It's the lowest-friction interchange format for downstream tools (Style Dictionary, Tokens Studio, Theo, etc.).

## Top-level shape

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/",
  "$description": "Design tokens for <project>. Generated by design-system-extractor.",
  "color": { ... },
  "font":  { ... },
  "space": { ... },
  "radius": { ... },
  "size":   { ... },
  "shadow": { ... },
  "motion": { ... },
  "z":      { ... }
}
```

## Token shape

Every leaf is an object with `$value` and `$type`:

```json
{
  "$value": "#3B82F6",
  "$type": "color",
  "$description": "Base brand blue."
}
```

References use `{path.to.token}` syntax:

```json
{
  "color": {
    "brand": {
      "500": { "$value": "#3B82F6", "$type": "color" }
    },
    "action": {
      "primary": {
        "bg": {
          "default": { "$value": "{color.brand.500}", "$type": "color" },
          "hover":   { "$value": "{color.brand.600}", "$type": "color" }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Typed primitives

| Token group | `$type` |
|---|---|
| color | `color` |
| spacing / size | `dimension` |
| radius | `dimension` |
| font.family | `fontFamily` |
| font.size | `dimension` |
| font.weight | `fontWeight` |
| line.height | `number` |
| letter.spacing | `dimension` |
| shadow | `shadow` |
| motion.duration | `duration` |
| motion.ease | `cubicBezier` |
| z | `number` |

## Composite tokens

`shadow` and `typography` may use composite values:

```json
{
  "shadow": {
    "md": {
      "$type": "shadow",
      "$value": {
        "color": "{color.gray.900}",
        "offsetX": "0px",
        "offsetY": "4px",
        "blur": "12px",
        "spread": "0px",
        "alpha": 0.08
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Layering convention

Mirror the 3-layer taxonomy:

```
color.<scale>.<step>           = primitive   (literal value)
color.<role>.<variant>         = semantic    (refs primitive)
color.<role>.<variant>.<state> = state       (refs semantic)
```

## Example minimal file

```json
{
  "color": {
    "brand": {
      "500": { "$value": "#3B82F6", "$type": "color" },
      "600": { "$value": "#2563EB", "$type": "color" }
    },
    "action": {
      "primary": {
        "bg": {
          "default": { "$value": "{color.brand.500}", "$type": "color" },
          "hover":   { "$value": "{color.brand.600}", "$type": "color" }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "space": {
    "0": { "$value": "0px",   "$type": "dimension" },
    "1": { "$value": "4px",   "$type": "dimension" },
    "2": { "$value": "8px",   "$type": "dimension" },
    "4": { "$value": "16px",  "$type": "dimension" }
  },
  "radius": {
    "md": { "$value": "8px", "$type": "dimension" }
  }
}
```
